items.title: Is It Too Late To Make Money On Accenture Stock After Its Rebound?
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) stock has returned about 51% over the past three months. Yet the shares are still down nearly 20% over twelve months and trade at roughly half their three-year high. At about $186 a share, the easy read is that the quick money has been made.
